extra.final_summary: Found and fixed two data problems: (1) species had 2 space-variant labels (' Adelie', 'Adelie ') — normalized to 'Adelie'; (2) body_mass_g was stored as text with thousands separators (3 values like '3,450') — cast to numeric with 0 values lost. Verified no duplicate rows and no body_mass values outside the allowed 2500–6500 g range. Average body mass by species (55 rows): Adelie 3767.2 g, Chinstrap 3726.8 g, Gentoo 4895.8 g. Caveat: one row has missing sex, but that doesn't affect this question.
